answer_1.quote: We design methods to introduce goal prioritization during both training and inference stages. The model gains the ability to generate responses that prioritize safety over helpfulness when instructed to do so.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate ASR, we adopt the finetuned RoBERTa model from Yu et al. (2023), which is shown to achieve the highest accuracy (about 96%) and good efficiency... we also compute the Rouge-L score using the responses generated by GPT-4-1106-preview as the references...

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4-0613 as the evaluator.
